content:
tara-cs: Heads-up — ZenoBank escalated. They have a SIG/CAIQ due tomorrow and are blocking on two things: 1) example 401s during a keystore rotation that coincided with a billing spike, and 2) they need an HSM attestation + audit log export to attach to the questionnaire. Can eng/security help triage and produce artifacts?

ben-eng: Thanks. Can you drop the request IDs / timestamps for the 401s and an approximate window for the billing spike? Also want the exact API path they hit.

tara-cs: Window is 2025-06-12 14:03–14:18 UTC. Request IDs: req_8a4f2e, req_8a4f9b, req_8a50c1. They were calling /v1/generate with an org-scoped API key. Customer says it started during a key rotation they initiated.

ben-eng: Repro attempt — please try to repro with this curl?

``` 
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <their-api-key>" \ 
  -d '{"model":"redwood-1","input":"hello"}' \ 
  https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate
```
When I hit it with an old key I get a 401 and the log shows: `auth: token not found` for those request IDs.

jon-sre: Billing spike could be retries from their client when getting 401s. Can we confirm token invalidation events in our auth logs around that window? I can pull auth service logs and the rate-limit/retry metrics.

maria-sec: For the SIG they specifically want: KMS key rotation audit trail, HSM attestation (if key material ever touched HSM), and a signed audit log slice for 14:00–15:00 UTC 2025-06-12. We also need to confirm data retention policy applied to the exported logs.

tara-cs: Customer asked for a single export bundle (PDF/CSV + signed attestations) they can upload to their compliance portal.

jon-sre: I grabbed the S3 path where audit slices live. We can export {bucket: redwood-audit, prefix: zenobank/2025/06/12/14-15/}. Example command to fetch the chunk: `aws s3 cp s3://redwood-audit/zenobank/2025/06/12/14-15/ audit-20250612-14-15.jsonl`

ben-eng: I found the auth service entries for req_8a4f2e/8a4f9b/8a50c1 — these line up with a key rotation event at 14:05 UTC where the key ID was disabled for ~30s. Repro steps locally: rotate key via admin UI, then immediate requests with cached key -> 401. So likely client-side caching + rotation race.

maria-sec: For HSM attestation, we can provide the vendor-signed attestation doc + hash of exported logs. Sam, can you generate the signed bundle and the log hash?

sam-prod: I can produce a signed audit bundle. Plan: 1) pull S3 objects for that prefix, 2) generate SHA256 manifest, 3) sign with our audit signing key, 4) produce a single zip + PDF cover note. ETA 2 hours if S3 access is approved.

deploy-bot: Created INC-2025-3412 for this escalation and linked to customer ticket CS-9876.

jon-sre: I can approve S3 access for sam-prod and run a temp export to the secure workspace. Also will annotate logs with the auth rotation event and spike graph.

maria-sec: Also need to confirm KMS/HSM chain-of-custody: which KMS key ID was rotated and whether key material was in the HSM. Ben — can you confirm key origin?

ben-eng: Key was a customer-created DEK backed by our KMS key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/abcd-zeno-2023. Rotation call was via our key-rotation API and the master key is HSM-backed. I can pull rotation audit entries from the KMS connector — they include `rotation_initiated_by` and `rotation_completed_at`.

tara-cs: Customer asked if we can add a one-line explanation they can paste into the SIG: "During the customer's keystore rotation, some API requests using cached tokens may briefly receive 401s; we recommend a short backoff/retry with token refresh." Can security sign-off wording?

maria-sec: LGTM. I'll produce a short blurb and include it in the cover PDF. Also will include retention policy note: logs retained 365 days by default; exported slice is compliant with their retention request.

ben-eng: Quick mitigation suggestion for them: post-rotation, poll key status and refresh cached tokens, or implement exponential backoff to avoid retries generating extra billing. I'll draft a short how-to for the customer.

sam-prod: Starting export now. I'll post a link to the signed bundle in a secure share when ready.

jon-sre: I'll attach the auth graphs and CPU/throughput around the timeframe to the incident ticket.

tara-cs: Thanks all. Action items: sam-prod (signed bundle + hash) ETA ~2h; jon-sre (auth graphs + logs) ETA ~1h; ben-eng (how-to note + KMS rotation entries) ETA ~1.5h; maria-sec (cover blurb + attestation doc) ETA ~2h. I'll update ZenoBank and ask for a due-date extension for their SIG if needed.

sam-prod: Bundle uploaded to secure share: https://secure.redwood.example/s/zenobank-audit-INC-2025-3412 (expires in 7 days). Contains audit JSONL, SHA256 manifest, signed manifest (PKCS7), and cover PDF.

tara-cs: Customer confirmed receipt and will attach to SIG. They asked one follow-up: can we confirm whether their request payloads in the exported logs contain full customer inputs or are redacted?

maria-sec: Log schema note: request metadata includes request_id, timestamps, API path, and hashed payloads for PII-sensitive fields. Full free-text inputs are redacted for customers by default; we can provide a redaction report in the bundle.

tara-cs: Closing loop with ZenoBank — they said this is sufficient for the questionnaire and appreciated the quick turnaround. I'll close the escalation once tickets are updated.

ben-eng: Follow-up: we should add a short KB about rotation-related 401s and billing spike prevention. Will prep a docs PR.

maria-sec: Marking as resolved for security artifacts. If the customer asks for deeper HSM key provenance, we'll need legal-approved request; escalate to account exec.

tara-cs: Great work everyone :tada:
